data.name: Sicham Universe : Let's Sicham Today!
data.detailed_description:
A Large-Scale Online Party Game For Audience Participation Streams

Sicham Universe is a large-scale online party game built specifically for audience participation streams.

In a viewer participation stream, the audience does not just watch from the outside. Viewers step into the content, play alongside the streamer, and help create the moments that happen live.

I have always loved that kind of stream participation, and I wanted to make a game where many more people could jump in at the same time. Sicham Universe is not a regular multiplayer game with streaming features added on top. It is designed from the start around streamer-and-viewer participation.

The streamer opens a room, viewers join, and everyone runs, bumps into each other, competes, and reacts in the same world. Play through short minigame rounds and become a participant inside the stream instead of only watching it.

Varied Minigames

Each round has a different rule set and objective. Sometimes you survive alone. Sometimes you work with your team.

  • Stay on collapsing platforms in Lava Floor

  • Run from infection in Zombie Infection

  • Move to the correct answer zone in Quiz

  • Race through traps and obstacles in Obstacle Race

  • Pull together with your team in Tug of War

  • Dodge, throw, and survive in team Dodgeball

  • Push a giant ball toward the goal in Ball Rolling

  • Pass the baton and race as a team in Relay Race

Designed For Live Streams

Sicham Universe is not built around a small four-player party. It is designed around live stream situations where many viewers may want to join at once.

The streamer leads the flow of the room, and participants receive new roles and goals from one minigame to the next. Short rounds, clear rules, and fast transitions make the game easy to follow during a stream.

Moments Created By The Crowd

You do not have to play perfectly for something fun to happen. The core of Sicham Universe is the scene created when many people run, push, fall, collide, and rush toward the same goal together.

Sometimes one player wins through skill. Sometimes an entire team moves as a chaotic crowd. Unexpected collisions, ragdolls, mistakes, and comebacks create new stream moments every round.

Key Features

  • Designed specifically around streamer-and-viewer participation

  • Large-scale multiplayer structure built with up to 100-player sessions in mind

  • Minigames across races, survival, team battles, quizzes, and more

  • Short rounds and fast transitions for party-game pacing

  • Character customization and a social hub

  • Audience participation features designed with stream chat integration in mind

From Watching The Stream To Joining It

Sicham Universe is not a game where viewers only watch from the side.

It is a game where streamers and viewers enter the same space, play the same rounds, laugh at the same moments, and create the same results together.

Start a stream where the viewers become the main characters.

data.short_description: Sicham Universe is a large-scale online party game built specifically for audience participation streams. Streamers and viewers gather in the same space to play races, survival games, team battles, quizzes, and other real-time minigames together.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7th Gen / AMD Ryzen 3 1st Gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 9th Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 3rd Gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 or AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
